# laya-go follow prompt v2 golden request

`request.json` is laya-go's `games/follow/prompt/testdata/v2_sample_request.json` (laya-go commit `5b9aeac`, branch `minecraft`). Same terrain, bot and player as v1 (see ../laya-follow-v1/README.md), plus mobs: a zombie at (5, 1) and a skeleton at (9, 9), which the bot at (1, 3) sees as `zombie E4 N2` and `skeleton E8 S6`.
